sql:
SELECT l.name AS league_name, COUNT(m.id) AS game_count
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY l.name
ORDER BY game_count DESC
LIMIT 4
